title: Hell's Angels chief zapped at Skinwalker Ranch

tellings.quote: has another story of a Hell's Angels chief or whatever, you know, getting zapped and then a catatonic steak just just, you know, paralyzed there.

plain: A leader of the Hell's Angels motorcycle club is said to have been "zapped" at Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events, and left paralyzed and catatonic on the spot. Michels mentions it only in passing and credits the story to a man named Brandon Fugal. If true, it would be one more case of the ranch physically harming the people who go there.
